connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed identical to US3_MS3: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -10.761) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 7.10 mm) touching the radiating edge y=-3.661 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

P01_MS1.note: Single design variable: transformer length. The 50 ohm line shortens by the same amount because the board edge is fixed (consequence; it changes only the phase of S11 at a 50 ohm reference). Patch, transformer width, material, board, port unchanged.

rationale: Step 1 of a 3-step single-variable feed retune proposed by em/feed_retune_guide.py (GUIDE_MODEL, not EM) from the P01_MS1 fine-mesh run 026: de-embedding the 50 ohm line and the lambda/4 transformer gives Z_patch(f); lengthening the transformer to 7.1 mm is predicted to widen the -10 dB band from 535 to 655 MHz (channel worst -8.22 -> -9.15 dB). Next steps (if the model holds): tr_w 0.8 -> 0.5 mm (predicted -10.43 dB), then tr_l 7.1 -> 7.6 mm (predicted -11.66 dB).

computation.note: Prediction is for the FINE mesh (model built on run 026); this round runs the BASE mesh, which in 025/026 was 0.17 dB better on the worst case.

manufacturability.note: Transformer 0.80 x 7.10 mm; 50 ohm line 3.92 x 2.239 mm; no slots.

purpose: Test the feed-retune guide model with one variable (transformer length) on the plain rectangle, aiming at -10 dB over the whole channel.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Base mesh, lumped port: the -10 dB band is wider than P01_MS1 base (025: 7.798-8.345 GHz, 547 MHz), i.e. the guide model's widening holds qualitatively.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: Channel worst |S11| on the base mesh is within 1 dB of the guide-model value scaled to base (about -9.3 dB).
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 true -> step 2 (tr_w 0.5 mm) next round. H1 false -> the guide model is not usable; stop the feed path and report.
